speaker: VOICE
text: You're inside a reconstruction of the Asterion—the ship where the experiment happened. You're seeing it through Arin's memories.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: These are my memories... so why do they feel hostile?

speaker: VOICE
text: The Watchers are corrupted memory fragments. They patrol these halls and can detect you. Crouch in the dark cover patches to stay hidden.

speaker: VOICE
text: The research terminal is to the east. Hold E to investigate it. The scan takes time and makes noise, so stay alert.
